headline: Sleep under the shanyrak.
intro: Journeys from a weekend to a full month across alpine lakes, high passes and summer pastures — every night in a traditional yurt camp, hosted by nomad families.
experiencesIntro: Ride across the jailoo, meet an eagle hunter, press felt with your host family and fall asleep under a sky full of stars.
howIntro: No payment online. Send a request, we confirm it personally, then you travel.

request.title: Send a request
request.body: The request is not a payment. Choose a trip, a departure and your group size.

confirm.title: We confirm
confirm.body: Within 24 hours we check seats with our local partners and confirm by email, with payment details.

travel.title: Travel
travel.body: Once confirmed, your guide and host families take care of the rest.

ctaBody: Choose a departure and send your request — we reply personally.
ctaIntro: Every night of your trip is spent in a yurt camp run by a local family — the same felt homes nomads have lived in for centuries, set on high summer pastures by lakes and mountains.

ctaPoints.sleep: Thick felt tushuk mattresses with warm blankets
ctaPoints.stove: A stove lit in the evening when the mountain air turns cold
ctaPoints.meals: Home-cooked meals at your host family’s table
